rate_limits: free per-company overview; bulk extracts + certified certificates are paid (gjaldskrá)
notes: The authoritative company register, keyed on the 10-digit kennitala (= company id = tax id). Free per-company overview (gjaldfrjálst yfirlit) exposes name, kennitala, registered address (lögheimili), municipality (sveitarfélag), legal form (rekstrarform, e.g. E1 Einkahlutafélag ehf), ÍSAT activity, VSK status, and the chair (forráðamaður, personal data). Verified live: JBT Marel ehf. (6204830369), Icelandair ehf. (4612023490). NO open bulk/API — bulk extracts and certified certificates (Staðfest vottorð) are paid (a fee schedule/gjaldskrá applies).

rate_limits: filed for public disclosure; retrieval paid per-document
notes: Companies file annual accounts electronically (Hnappurinn, rafræn skil) with the Annual Accounts Register for public disclosure ('til opinberrar birtingar'). The financial statements exist and are public, but retrieval is paid per-document — no open bulk/XBRL download found. Keyed on kennitala. Cataloged from public docs.

VAT (VSK) registration status is shown within the Fyrirtækjaskrá per-company search. The VSK number is a separate registration from the kennitala. Iceland has VAT (VSK). Per-company lookup only; no open bulk.
The Icelandic open-data portal (opingogn.is) now redirects to island.is. It does not openly host the company register; the legacy CKAN API is gone. Cataloged for completeness.
